normalization_rule.archive_format: ZIP only; a non-ZIP response fails closed
normalization_rule.equality_rule: Pass only if the two sorted manifests have identical normalized path sets and each corresponding entry has identical type, bytes, byte count and executable-bit state.
normalization_rule.included_entries: All regular files and symbolic links after root removal. Directory entries are structural only and excluded from the manifest.
normalization_rule.large_payload_rule: Do not retain the downloaded ZIP bodies in the packet. Retain URL, final URL, HTTP status, headers, byte count, MD5, SHA-256 and exact normalized per-entry manifests.
normalization_rule.root_normalization: Remove exactly one top-level directory component from every non-directory member independently in each ZIP. Reject any archive with zero or multiple top-level roots.
normalization_rule.safe_paths: Reject absolute paths, parent traversal and entries outside exactly one archive root directory.
